confidence_notes: Available [Munnar food estimates](https://solosquare.app/cost-of-living/munnar) and [Kerala restaurant averages](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/admin1Unit?country=India&unit=Kerala) are rough proxies for July 2026. Draft beer availability and seasonal accommodation prices are uncertain. Cocktail and wine estimates use beer-price relationships, informed by [Kochi bar prices](https://www.ecokochi.com/blog/bars-and-pubs-in-kochi-where-to-go-for-a-drink/). Accommodation is a holistic estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kerala restaurant prices and Kochi bar prices provide regional context, adjusted for Munnar's smaller size and tourist demand.
